column3: The manager did not accuse me of making the mistake. (經理沒有指控是我犯了那個錯誤。)
Don't leave the milk out or it will spoil. (別把牛奶放在外面，否則會變質。)
The construction of the new office will finish soon. (新辦公室的建設很快就會完成。)
Please send your request by email to the team. (請透過電子郵件將您的請求發送給團隊。)
This company has a good reputation for customer service. (這家公司在客戶服務方面有很好的聲譽。)
Can the small business survive this difficult year? (這家小企業能度過這艱難的一年嗎？)
The jury found the man guilty of the crime. (陪審團裁定該男子犯有此罪。)
The lawyer is working on a very important case. (律師正在處理一個非常重要的案件。)
We decided to outsource our IT support to a firm. (我們決定將 IT 支援外包給一家公司。)
Both sides signed the agreement this morning. (雙方今天早上簽署了協議。)
